content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments refer to the ability to process transactions using the Solana blockchain, a high-speed network ideal for digital commerce. This matters because conventional payment platforms like Gumroad and PayPal often charge hefty fees, limiting the profits of creators. For instance, Gumroad takes a 10% cut on every sale, while NOWPayments only charges a mere 0.5%. This difference means that for 100 sales of a $97 product, creators stand to retain $921 more by choosing Solana payments. By leveraging this infrastructure, creators can sell digital products while maintaining higher profit margins and full ownership of their data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture supporting Solana payments leverages various components that work together seamlessly. At its core, you have NOWPayments for crypto transaction processing, which connects directly to the Solana network. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment goes through an on-chain verification process, ensuring speed and security. Additionally, automated delivery of products can be managed via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, allowing for instant access to digital goods after payment confirmation. This stack eliminates the reliance on centralized platforms, providing a sovereign solution for digital creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This framework is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors have failed them. Whether you're selling ebooks, online courses, templates, or software, this architecture is built to cater to your needs. It empowers creators from countries like Ethiopia, Venezuela, or Zimbabwe to establish a fully operational online store without the constraints of conventional platforms. By utilizing Solana payments, you gain autonomy over your business and can sell your products without the worry of severe transaction fees or account limitations.
Save more money with 0.5% payment processing fees instead of 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of utilizing Solana payments hinges on several key components. First, you have the NOWPayments service, which allows for automatic cryptocurrency payment processing with minimal fees. Next, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script provides the backend logic necessary for handling transactions and delivering digital products. Order storage can be managed through Supabase or Google Sheets, while file delivery can be conducted via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This combination ensures that all parts of your digital commerce stack operate fluidly, offering a cohesive solution for creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack, start by selecting the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from COREMERCH. This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need to get started. Next, set up your product listings and configure NOWPayments for Solana transactions. Afterward, use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery. Store your orders in Supabase or Google Sheets to maintain full control over customer data. Finally, launch your store and begin selling digital products with confidence, knowing you have a robust infrastructure backing you.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This service allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, ensuring secure and instant transactions. By implementing a solution based on Solana payments, you not only avoid platform fees but also gain complete control over your sales and data.
Gain complete control over your data and sales without reliance on platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without traditional platform fees, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all necessary resources. This kit enables you to build your own digital store at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, ensuring you can operate independently of payment restrictions.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate Solana payments into my digital store?

Integrating Solana payments involves setting up a NOWPayments account and configuring it to accept transactions in your preferred cryptocurrencies. You'll also need to implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment verification and product delivery.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept through NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, enabling you to choose the best options for your audience. Popular choices like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins are available, providing flexibility in payment methods for your digital products.
What are the fees associated with Solana payments?

NOWPayments charges a competitive fee of only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%. This allows you to maximize your earnings from each sale while ensuring a sustainable business model.
Can I sell different types of digital products using this infrastructure?

Yes, this infrastructure is versatile and can handle various digital products such as ebooks, courses, templates, and software. The automated delivery system ensures that customers receive their purchases instantly after payment confirmation.
How can I ensure the security of my transactions?

Using NOWPayments and the Solana blockchain ensures secure and transparent transactions. On-chain payment verification adds an extra layer of security, so you can trust that your sales are processed reliably.
